text: Okay, so the issue is with the Wireless Earbud I ordered. Yeah, I mistakenly got one with an IPX7 water resistance level, but I don't actually need that much. I want to exchange it for a different one, ideally with the same water resistance level as the other ones I got, but honestly, the cheapest one from that whole order would be fine too.
zh: 好的，所以问题出在我订购的无线耳机上。是的，我误买了一个IPX7防水等级的，但我实际上并不需要那么高的防水等级。我想换一个，最好是和我买的其他的防水等级一样的，但说实话，那个订单里最便宜的那个也行。
